title: Masked Aadhaar
hook: HR wants all 12 digits of my Aadhaar

beats.say: HR wants my whole Aadhaar by six. Is that okay?
beats.show: HR wants my whole Aadhaar by 6. Is that okay?

screen.title: HR (Recruiter)
screen.body:
Hi Meera, pls send Aadhaar front & back + PAN before 6 pm.
Interview tmrw 11 am.

beats.say: Great question! Here are eleven considerations.

screen.title: 11 considerations
screen.body:
1. Context matters
2. How do you feel about it?
3. Privacy, broadly
4. Trust, generally
5. It depends
...
11. Consider consulting a professional

beats.say: Easy! Aadhaar, PAN, bank details and a selfie for luck. Sending!
Send the masked one. Last four digits.
beats.show: Send the masked one. Last 4 digits.

screen.title: Masked Aadhaar: 4 steps
screen.body:
1. Open myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in, log in with OTP
2. Download Aadhaar, tick 'masked Aadhaar'
3. PDF password: first 4 letters of your name in CAPITALS + birth year (e.g. MEER1999)
4. Check Authentication History to see where your Aadhaar was used

Comment AADHAAR for the steps

beats.say: I'm so sorry. I should have just said that. Shall I list why?

caption:
hr wanted all 12 digits of my aadhaar on chat by 6 pm. the AIs had opinions.

download the masked aadhaar from myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in: it shows only the last 4 digits. the PDF password is the first 4 letters of your name in capitals plus your birth year.

has a recruiter ever asked for your aadhaar before the interview? yes or no.

Comment AADHAAR and I'll DM you the masked aadhaar steps, how to check where your aadhaar was used, and 3 prompts to reply to HR politely.
